CustomField.description: What a practitioner said this would take, before anyone did it. Deliberately a separate field from Actual_Effort_Points__c: an expert's judgement calibrating another judgement is not measurement, and mixing the two would let the model look measured when it is only agreed-with.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A practitioner's estimate. Not an outcome — see Actual Effort Points for that.
CustomField.label: Expert Estimate Points
